 New GTA VI Update Released And Not Everyone Has Gotten It, Here’s Why
 By Aaron Trueman November 16, 2026 
 GTA 6 
 Share 
 Twitter 
 Facebook 
 Bluesky 
 Pinterest 
 Reddit 
 WhatsApp 
 Threads 
 Email 
 Copy Link 
 Rockstar Games have released a second pre-launch update for Grand Theft Auto VI on PlayStation 5 and XBOX Series X|S. However, some players will have to wait.
 On Monday morning, Rockstar issued a new bug fixing update for the game to all of those who have already pre-loaded the title. This is a mandatory update that must be installed before playing the game on November 19th.
 Download Sizes
 The patch comes in at 1.59GB on XBOX Series X|S and 602.5mb on PS5 (varies a little per region). As for version number, it is now 1.0.2.1 on XBOX and 1.002.001 on PS5 so an incremental build change. GTA VI’s install size on XBOX now sits at 211.9GB.
 Download Times
 Whilst every XBOX user has the update right away, Sony and Rockstar are gradually rolling out the patch to PS5 users. Much like with update 01.002.000, only a selection of the playerbase have received the download. This is to reduce load on PSN servers because of the sheer amount of data being transferred by millions of people.
 According to the reputable @PlaystationSize , 33% of users have gotten the update. At 10pm GMT, a further 33% will get the update. The remainder of the pre-ordered players will get it at 10am GMT on Tuesday November 17th. Given that this update finishes rolling out a little over 24 hours before the game goes live in New Zealand, it’s possible that this is the final update before the game comes out.
 In other Grand Theft Auto VI news, an article published over the weekend contains a number of new gameplay details . Plus, physical copies have faced redeem code issues, covered here .
